LanguageData.NSIF_MasterSwitchDesc: Master switch for all refrigerator beds. Per-refrigerator choices are preserved while disabled.
LanguageData.NSIF_IcyCoreRecoveryDesc: Nivarians resting in a powered refrigerator bed recover Icy Core at the base rate of a Nivarian bed.
LanguageData.NSIF_IcecreamTailRecoveryBoostDesc: Nivarians resting in a powered refrigerator bed recover an immature Icecream Tail faster. Requires the Icecream Tail mod.
LanguageData.NSIF_CapacityReductionDesc: Reduce refrigerator capacity while its bed is enabled. Disable this to make all refrigerator beds use no storage capacity.
LanguageData.NSIF_SingleBedMaximumReductionDesc: A single refrigerator bed still halves capacity, but cannot reduce it by more than this value. Set this to 0 to use no capacity.
LanguageData.NSIF_DoubleBedMaximumReductionDesc: A double refrigerator bed still halves capacity, but cannot reduce it by more than this value. Set this to 0 to use no capacity.
LanguageData.NSIF_AllowSleepingDesc: Allow colonist Nivarians to use this refrigerator as a bed.
LanguageData.NSIF_MasterSwitchDisabled: Refrigerator sleeping is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.NSIF_OnlyNivarianColonists: Only colonist Nivarians can sleep here.
LanguageData.NSIF_InteractionMoodDesc: Storing or taking items affects the sleeper and the interacting pawn while a Nivarian sleeps inside.
LanguageData.NSIF_SleepMoodDesc: Nivarians sleeping in a refrigerator bed gain an additional thought based on its available space.
